package repository

import (
	"context"

	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain"
)

type CourseAssignmentRepository interface {
	Assign(
		ctx context.Context,
		assignment domain.StudentCourseAssignment,
		request domain.CourseAssignmentRequest,
	) (domain.StudentCourseAssignment, bool, error)
	Get(ctx context.Context, studentID, courseID string) (domain.StudentCourseAssignment, error)
	List(ctx context.Context, studentID string) ([]domain.StudentCourseAssignment, error)
}
